title: Straightening cocartesian fibrations over arbitrary infinity categories
statement:
Use the infinity-category, mapping-space and universe conventions of [def-coef-complete-algebroid]. For any infinity category $S$ in a fixed universe, let $\operatorname{coCart}(S)$ be the infinity category of cocartesian fibrations over $S$ and functors over $S$ preserving cocartesian arrows, in a sufficiently large universe. The simplicial convention for these fibrations is [def-coef-infinity-fibrations]; intrinsically a cocartesian arrow $u:x\to y$ of a functor $q:X\to S$ is characterized by the homotopy-pullback square
$$\begin{matrix}\operatorname{Map}_X(y,z)&\longrightarrow&\operatorname{Map}_X(x,z)\\
\downarrow&&\downarrow\\
\operatorname{Map}_S(qy,qz)&\longrightarrow&\operatorname{Map}_S(qx,qz)\end{matrix}$$
for every $z\in X$, and a cocartesian fibration is a functor admitting such a lift from every $x$ over every arrow out of $qx$. This intrinsic convention is equivalent, after replacement over $S$, to the simplicial one. Fibers and base changes in the intrinsic convention are infinity-categorical pullbacks; for a simplicial cocartesian fibration these are represented by its simplicial fibers and base changes. There is an equivalence
$$\operatorname{St}_S:\operatorname{coCart}(S)\simeq\operatorname{Fun}(S,\operatorname{Cat}_\infty),$$
where $\operatorname{Cat}_\infty$ denotes infinity categories and functors of the chosen size and has finite products given by products of infinity categories, with terminal object the one-object terminal category. For $q:X\to S$, its image has value $X_s$ at $s$ and sends $f:s\to t$ to cocartesian transport $f_!:X_s\to X_t$. For every $a:T\to S$, straightening identifies $a^*q$ with $(\operatorname{St}_Sq)\circ a$, naturally and with all higher coherences. The space of choices of a classifying functor together with its classification equivalence is contractible.
